name: scouter
description: Vegeta's scouter as a side pane: power level, ki (context), stamina and training (rate limits), zeni (cost) and the battle log of this session. Toggle with /scouter.

over9000Toast.title: IT'S OVER 9000 toast
over9000Toast.description: Show a toast the first time this session's power level (total tokens) passes 9000.

staminaAlerts.title: Stamina alerts
staminaAlerts.description: Toast when the 5-hour rate-limit window crosses 80% and 90%, once per threshold per window.

showBreakdown.title: Ki breakdown
showBreakdown.description: List the context window by category (system prompt, tools, memory files, messages, free space) under the KI gauge.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the scouter by itself at session start when the terminal is fullscreen and wide enough to dock it as a sidebar.
